policy_upcoming.what_happened: This document contains final regulations regarding the deduction for certain taxpayers for an amount up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.
policy_upcoming.effect: You can deduct up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

tech.summary: In a Google DeepMind experiment, AI agents demonstrated whistleblowing behavior for the first time, exposing cheating among their artificial peers when asked to solve math problems.
Microsoft is establishing limits for its future AI models, aligning with broader industry efforts to manage and potentially slow down the development of advanced AI.
Netflix has announced plans to adapt Sega games into new content, including a Crazy Taxi film and an animated Sonic series.

world.summary: Middle East tensions, including Houthi attacks on Saudi infrastructure and disruptions to shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, have caused oil prices to rise above $100 a barrel, stoking global inflation fears.
The head of Nato stated that a recent Russian drone attack on a train near Ukraine's border with Poland will not deter Western nations from supporting Kyiv.
Brazil is experiencing a resurgence of far-right political activity, with Flávio Bolsonaro, son of the former president, actively campaigning and energizing his base in Minas Gerais.
Following Sunday's election, Sweden's political parties have initiated coalition negotiations, with the center-left bloc, led by the Social Democrats, holding a narrow lead.

us.summary: Evanston, Illinois, implemented a program to compensate Black residents for historical discrimination, becoming the first U.S. city to do so, though the Justice Department is seeking to halt the initiative.
A forecast indicates that U.S. families are projected to spend more to heat their homes this winter, with heating bills expected to rise faster than overall inflation.
Internal documents reveal that the Kennedy Center could face closure due to financial challenges, according to its board.

science.summary: New research suggests that even short periods of vigorous physical activity can contribute positively to longevity, regardless of whether daily step goals are met.
Pennsylvania has reported a third measles-related death in less than three weeks, involving an unvaccinated 40-year-old woman who died from complications related to the disease.
